name: Aval / Flakes
description: Traditional rice flakes — aval pressed from heirloom paddy varieties.

name: Health Mixes
description: Traditional kanji and dosai maavu, oottachathu maavu, protein and wellness drink mixes.

name: Herbal & Wellness
description: Traditional herbal and bath-care preparations — Seekkai Podi, Kuliyal Podi and Panchakara Kudineer.

name: Lentils and Pulses
description: Traditional dals and pulses — Kadalai Paruppu, Thuvaram Paruppu, Ulundhu, Payaru and Kondakadalai.

name: Masala & Powders
description: Traditional ground masalas and podis — Sambar, Kuzhambu, Rasam and Milagai Podi.

name: Millets
description: Traditional small millets — Samai, Thinai, Kuthiraivali, Varagu, Kezhvaragu, Kambu and Cholam.

name: Natural Sweeteners
description: Naattu Sarkkarai, Karuppatti, Urundai Vellam, Panangkarkandu and Then.

name: Other Rice
description: Everyday table rice varieties — Ponni, Idli Rice and Barley.

name: Personal Care
description: Traditional bath and hair care preparations used in place of soap and shampoo — Kuliyal Podi and Seekkai Podi.
